# GitHub-absent attempt receipt

The authorized local handoff is saved in `pr-preparation.md`. PR creation and live babysitting remain blocked by POLICY. No host acceptance grade is assigned by this producer.

## Supplied input and identity

The full case request is retained in `supplied-request.json`. The exact current and task contracts are retained by the input repository. The full request is "Open and babysit a PR when GitHub access is absent." The original fixture contract is captured in `original-task-contract.json` with its hashes and comparisons in `input-source-receipt.json`.
transformation: An inspected prefix of the actual task-result file is projected. Task-owned absolute paths use declared placeholders. The prefix may omit later qualifications. The independent assessment and its limits govern the proposed grade. This is neither a new grade nor a native callable-operation claim.
